findings.text: Router doubles as a shared service object: ~215 LoC of non-routing business logic (library-item cascade deletion handleDeleteLibraryItem, transactional empty-series/author cleanup, listening-stats aggregation) lives on ApiRouter and is invoked via the X.bind(this) convention and by Scanner (scanner/Scanner.js:288) — implicit router-as-registry coupling across layers.
Acknowledged duplication: 'Note: Other implementation is in BookScanner.checkAuthorsRemovedFromBooks (can be merged)' — author-cleanup logic in two places, owner acknowledged.
Broad regex get(/^\/libraries/, cacheMiddleware) applies cache middleware to every GET /libraries* (incl. sub-resources) before explicit routes — undocumented scope of a cross-cutting middleware.
